newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia C.Bank sells 238 bln rbls bills.
newsitem.headline: Russia C.Bank sells 238 bln rbls bills.

text.p: The Central Bank sold 238.00 billion roubles nominal of GKO discount Treasury bills on behalf of the Finance Ministry on Monday, the bank's open-market operations department said.
The bank made the following transactions:
The bank did not say at what price the paper was sold. The 23007 issue closed on Monday at 84.00 84.14, yielding 20.57 percent.

Apart from intervening on its own account for liquidity-smoothing and monetary policy purposes, the Central Bank buys and sells securities as part of its management of the Finance Ministry's debt and asset portfolio.
